subject: general
question: Identify the correct sequential order of the excretory system in human beings.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kidney, ureters, urinary bladder, urethra **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**** Kidneys:**

 
• The kidneys are vital organs located on **either side of the backbone**, protected by the ribs and back muscles.
 
• Each human adult kidney has a** length of approximately 10-12 cm, a width of 5-7 cm, **and weighs around **120-170 grams.**
 
• **Medulla** is the inner zone, which extends between **medullary pyramids as renal columns **(columns of Bertin).
 
• **Nephrons is the functional units of the kidney, consisting of glomerulus and renal tubule**
 
• Each kidney has over **one million nephrons,** which carry out the process of **forming urine.**
 
• **Bowman’s capsule **is a cup-like structure enclosing the **glomerulus.**

**​Ureters:**

 
• The ureters are tubes that carry **urine from the kidneys to the bladder.**
 
• Each kidney has its** own** ureter.
 
• Ureters **transport urine** using peristaltic contractions.

**Urinary Bladder:**

 
• The urinary bladder is a **muscular sac** that stores urine until it is ready for elimination.
 
• When the bladder is full, nerve signals **trigger the urge to urinate.**

**​Urethra:**

 
• The urethra is the** final part **of the excretory system.
 
• It **connects** the bladder to the external environment.
 
• During urination, the **urethra allows **urine to pass out of the body.
